pages.heading: Devil's Hole Pupfish
pages.body: A very restricted underground aquifer population. Use a Strange Fish Finder to search for its home chunk. Pupfish graze on submerged mossy blocks, sometimes

pages.heading: Devil's Hole Pupfish (cont.)
pages.body: dislodging slimeballs, and reproduce after feeding there. Bucket specimens for transport; preserve a suitable feeding area when building a habitat.
